name: Dehati Comapny
tagline: Every trade your property needs, under one contract
description: Electrical, plumbing, construction, interiors, furniture, painting, carpentry and planned maintenance for homes, offices, shops and commercial buildings.

whyChooseUs.title: Our own tradesmen
whyChooseUs.description: Every electrician, plumber, mason and carpenter is on our payroll, police-verified and in uniform. No subcontractors you have never met.

whyChooseUs.title: Written, itemised quotes
whyChooseUs.description: Materials, labour and timeline listed line by line before work starts. If scope changes, you approve the revision in writing first.

whyChooseUs.title: Dates we actually keep
whyChooseUs.description: Jobs are scheduled against a stage plan, and your supervisor sends a short progress update at the end of each working day.

whyChooseUs.title: Insured and warrantied
whyChooseUs.description: Workmen are insured on site and every job carries a 12-month workmanship warranty on top of the manufacturer's product warranty.

whyChooseUs.title: Branded materials only
whyChooseUs.description: We quote the brand and grade of every material, from wire to ply to paint, and leave the bills with you at handover.

whyChooseUs.title: We clean up
whyChooseUs.description: Debris is removed and the space is swept at the end of each day, not left for you to deal with at the end of the job.

process.title: Tell us what is wrong
process.description: Call, WhatsApp a photo, or send the form. We ask enough questions on the first call to know which trade to send.

process.title: Free site visit
process.description: A supervisor measures, checks access and existing services, and flags anything the job will uncover later.

process.title: Itemised quote
process.description: You get a written quote within 48 hours with materials, labour, timeline and payment stages spelled out.

process.title: Scheduled work
process.description: Trades arrive in sequence against the stage plan, with a daily update and photos from your supervisor.

process.title: Handover and snag list
process.description: We walk the site with you, fix the snags, hand over bills and certificates, and the 12-month warranty starts.
